notablePrerequisites: Mirrormade is a copy of Myth Unbound.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rograkh adding {C}{C}.
Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.
Both copies of Myth Unbound trigger, causing you to draw two cards.
Cast Rograkh from the command zone by paying {0} due to the cost reductions from both copies of Myth Unbound.
Repeat.
